units.source_text: 此时正值秋季京官任免之期。

en.t: At this time it was the autumn season for appointing and dismissing officials in the capital.

units.source_text: 朝廷决定任命源氏为太政大臣。

en.t: The court decided to appoint Genji as Grand Minister of State.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝预先将此事告知源氏内大臣，乘便向他说起最近所考虑的让位之事。

en.t: Emperor Reizei informed Genji, the Minister of the Center, of this in advance, and took the opportunity to speak to him about the abdication he had recently been considering.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣闻言，诚惶诚恐，认为此事万不可行，坚决反对。

en.t: When Genji heard this, he was filled with awe and alarm, judged that such a thing could never be allowed, and opposed it firmly.

units.source_text: 奏道：“桐壶父皇在世之时，于众多皇子之中，特别宠爱小臣，但绝不考虑传位之事。

en.t: He replied, "When my father, the Kiritsubo Emperor, was alive, he showed special affection for this humble servant among his many princes, but he never considered passing the throne to me.

units.source_text: 今日岂可违背父皇遗志，贸然身登帝位？

en.t: How could I now go against my father's wishes and rashly ascend the imperial throne myself?

units.source_text: 小臣但愿恪守遗命，为朝廷尽辅相之责。

en.t: I only wish to observe his command faithfully and fulfill my duty of assisting the court.

units.source_text: 直待年龄渐老之时，出家离俗，闭关修行，静度残生而已。”

en.t: When I have grown older, I hope simply to leave the world, become a monk, shut myself away in practice, and pass my remaining years in quiet."

units.source_text: 他照常用臣下的口气奏闻，冷泉帝听了深感歉憾。

en.t: He spoke, as always, in the tone of a subject addressing his sovereign, and Emperor Reizei felt deep regret when he heard it.

units.source_text: 至于太政大臣之职，源氏内大臣亦谓尚须考虑，暂不受命。

en.t: As for the office of Grand Minister of State, Genji also said that he still needed to consider it, and for the time being he did not accept the appointment.

units.source_text: 结果只是晋升官位，特许乘牛车出入宫禁。

en.t: In the end, he was only promoted in rank and specially permitted to enter and leave the palace precincts by ox carriage.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝深感不满，还要恢复源氏内大臣为亲王。

en.t: Emperor Reizei was deeply dissatisfied and also wanted to restore Genji, the Minister of the Center, to the status of imperial prince.

units.source_text: 但按定例，亲王不得兼太政大臣，源氏倘恢复为亲王，则别无适当人物可当太政大臣而为朝廷后援人，故此事又未能实行。

en.t: But according to established precedent, an imperial prince could not concurrently serve as Grand Minister of State; if Genji were restored as a prince, there would be no suitable person left to become Grand Minister and support the court, so this plan too could not be carried out.

units.source_text: 于是晋封权中纳言为大纳言兼大将。

en.t: Accordingly, the provisional Middle Counselor was promoted to Major Counselor and also made a general.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣想：“等待此人再升一级，成为内大臣以后，万事皆可委任此人，我多少总安闲些。”

en.t: Genji, the Minister of the Center, thought, "Once this man rises one more rank and becomes Minister of the Center, I can entrust everything to him and gain at least a little ease."

units.source_text: 但回思冷泉帝此次言行，又甚担心。

en.t: But when he thought back on Emperor Reizei's words and actions this time, he became deeply worried again.

units.source_text: 万一他已知道这秘密，则对不起藤壶母后之灵。

en.t: If by any chance the Emperor already knew this secret, Genji would have wronged the spirit of the Empress Mother Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 而使冷泉帝如此忧恼，又万分抱歉。

en.t: And to have caused Emperor Reizei such distress made him feel profoundly sorry as well.

units.source_text: 他很诧异：究竟是谁泄露这秘密的？

en.t: He was greatly puzzled: who on earth had revealed this secret?
